scripts.build:wf: bun run build:observability && bun run --cwd packages/wf build
scripts.build:cli: bun run build:wf && bun run --cwd apps/cli build
scripts.build:docs: cd apps/docs && uv run --no-project --with-requirements requirements.txt mkdocs build
scripts.build:site: bun run build:marketing && bun run build:docs
scripts.example:approval: cd examples/approval && bun run main.ts demo
scripts.test:all: bun test && bun run example:email && bun run example:quickstart && bun run example:order-saga && bun run example:approval && bun run example:campaign-rollout
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:all && bun run build:cli && bun run build:site && bun run build:dashboard
